methodology.startup: navigation through first completed draws for every mounted plot; five fresh contexts per production page
methodology.shader_cache: Shared OS/Metal cache is not cleared. Fresh-page startup is measured; genuinely cold shader compilation is not measured.
methodology.interactions: Two-second warmup, then three serial samples of at least five seconds. Each input waits for corresponding completed draws through public whenSettled barriers.
methodology.frame_times: CPU-observed intervals between completed draws, sampled by rAF; not GPU execution durations. Multiple increments in one observation share the interval. Counters observe the primary plot, except the sensor overview and taxi count plot; latency waits for all exposed linked handles.
methodology.latency: Browser performance.now from native input dispatch through public whenSettled across exposed linked handles and an explicit subsequent completed-frame counter advance; includes preparation and draw.
